name: Switch views and read the scale disclosure (console)
description: Validates the view switch, the Measured and Illustrated switch at the cut, and that the stage's info popover always states how much larger than life the current view is drawn.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Click the round info button at the bottom left of the 3D view (data-testid scale-info, labelled "Scale and data credits")
Assert the popover titled "How the view is drawn" shows a note (data-testid scale-note) containing "Depth is drawn 20 times deeper" and "the anchor 30 times"
Press Escape to close the popover, then click "At the cut" in the view switch (data-testid view-switch)
Assert a "Seabed detail" switch (data-testid detail-switch) with "Measured" and "Illustrated" appears and "Illustrated" is pressed (aria-pressed true)
Open the info popover again (data-testid scale-info)
Assert the note (data-testid scale-note) starts with "Close-up: the anchor is drawn 2 times its size"
Press Escape, then click "Measured" in the Seabed detail switch and open the info popover again
Assert the note (data-testid scale-note) contains "only the depth grid under the cut" and the URL query has view=closeup and detail=measured
Press Escape, then click "From above" in the view switch
Assert the Seabed detail switch is gone, "From above" is pressed, and the URL query has view=top
Assert the note (data-testid scale-note) again contains "Depth is drawn 20 times deeper"
